summary: Shopify's path depends on who will use the app. A custom app for one store needs no approval at all. A public app on the App Store goes through a real review against a published requirements checklist - expect homework, not just a form.

rationale: Custom single-store apps skip review entirely.
Public App Store apps face a documented requirements checklist and human review.
Extra applications (protected customer data, billing rules) can stack on top.

timeEstimate.setup: A few hours to create a Partner account, scaffold an app and complete OAuth on a development store.
timeEstimate.approval: For public apps, plan for about one to three weeks of review, longer if reviewers request changes.

basis.text: Shopify publishes the app review requirements and process; durations are community-reported, not a Shopify SLA.
The one-to-three-week window is an estimate, not a confirmed figure.

steps.title: Create a Partner account and an app
steps.detail: Sign up at partners.shopify.com, create an app, and note the API key and secret.

steps.title: Build against a development store
steps.detail: Development stores are free for partners. Install through the OAuth flow and request only the access scopes you use.

steps.title: Work through the app requirements checklist
steps.detail: Shopify publishes the checklist reviewers use: embedded-app rules, billing through the Billing API for paid apps, listing content, a screencast, and working installs.

steps.title: Submit and respond to reviewers
steps.detail: Reviews are human and specific. Budget time for at least one round of fixes.

requirements.item: Listing content and a screencast for public apps
Separate data-protection application if you need protected customer data

gotchas.text: Paid apps must use Shopify's Billing API - rolling your own checkout gets rejected.
Protected customer data (names, addresses, etc.) needs its own approval on top of app review.
Access scopes can only be requested at install time; adding scopes means merchants re-authorize.

agentCanDo: Re-read Shopify's authentication and app-requirements docs and refresh this guide
Walk the published requirements checklist against your app description
developerMustDo: Own the Partner account and the app
Record the screencast and write the listing
Submit for review and handle change requests
